sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Water Release, Wind Release

system.description:
This jutsu can only be cast while you are occupying a Ice Mirrors. You dash out of your mirror pane in a straight line, forcing all creatures you pass through to make a Dexterity saving throw, dealing [Weapons Damage] + 1d8 cold damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. You end this movement in a space that can hold you, adjacent to the end of the line.

If you would cross the space of a Ice Mirrors, you can change direction from this space, but you can only move up to 30 feet from the Ice Mirrors. You can dash from a Ice Mirrors in this way, once per casting.

A creature that is crossed multiple times only makes one saving throw. Increase the damage you deal by +1d8 cold damage for each time they are crossed as part of this jutsu’s casting.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the initial damage by 1d8 cold damage.
